stem: A 9-year-old child has a low total white cell count; which subtype of leukopaenia is most common?
explanation: Neutropaenia or lymphopaenia is the most common subtype of leukopaenia. A low total white cell count is therefore most often associated with a reduction in neutrophils or lymphocytes.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: WBC Disorders

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because eosinopaenia is not the most common subtype of leukopaenia.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because monocytopaenia is not the usual pattern described for leukopaenia.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because leukopaenia is most commonly due to neutropaenia or lymphopaenia.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because basophil depletion is not the typical common subtype of leukopaenia.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because isolated plasma cell loss is not a recognised common subtype of leukopaenia.
